Subtract <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>g</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g</annotation></semantics></math>: the region stops at the lower curve.

items.q: Find the area of the region bounded by <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = x + 1</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = x^2 - 1</annotation></semantics></math>.
